protocol: Five repetitions per app, sequential before and after arms. All earlier attempts retained.
ownerActivity: half and half; no per-repetition activity log
scope: Calculator eight clicks; TextEdit select/type/save in one owned file; Chess combined observation then Escape
timing: All durations in milliseconds. Guard reads are a subset of engine time. Caller reads are not guard time. Engine time ends at the matching JSON-RPC response without method.
limitations: Helper AX walk, screenshot capture, settling and IPC/transfer are not separately timed.
Parse probes are warm 1000-iteration loops, not individual whole-proxy timings.
SZOWRm and 28K0Ye have incomplete timing framing; zero or missing records do not mean zero guard cost.
Early pilot engine intervals may end at a colliding engine request ID; final complete arms preserve method and filter it.
jkVdVw claimed cleanup on insufficient evidence; that receipt is unconfirmed. Later b70Aba reports no TextEdit windows.
H2ChNF measured an earlier optimized revision before the final pending-read/screenshot fix. Retained separately, not used for final medians.
Guard logic and telemetry are cooperative JavaScript, not a security boundary. Native actions require await.
Chess titles and URLs are redacted; no screenshots or full accessibility contents are published.
